lastResponse.text: You did the right thing calling, and I’ll keep this quick. Main number first: dial two one one — that’s two, one, one. originalTexts: You did the right thing calling, and I’ll keep this quick. Main number first: dial **2-1-1** — that’s **two, one, one**. If your safety is at risk right now, call **9-1-1** immediately. If this phone dies, try any phone again and ask for 211info; they can connect you to a live person fast.
